text: Not a huge number, but I have a few really close friends that I've known since school. I'd rather have a small group of people I can completely trust than lots of friends I only see now and then. We still meet up almost every weekend.

tips.en: The speaker answers and explains the view through a comparison.
tips.kk: Автор жауап беріп, ұстанымын салыстырумен түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Автор отвечает и объясняет свою позицию сравнением.
tips.example: I'd rather have a small group of people I can completely trust

tips.en: I’ve known since school — accurate grammar for duration.
tips.kk: I’ve known since school — ұзақтыққа дәл грамматика.
tips.ru: I’ve known since school — точная грамматика для длительности.

note.en: A phrasal verb: meet by arrangement.

questions.question: Do you have a lot of friends?

text: It depends on the season. In summer we often go hiking in the mountains or just sit in a park and talk for hours. In winter we tend to stay inside — we'll go to a café, watch a film at someone's flat, or play board games, which are surprisingly popular in our group.

tips.en: Summer and winter give an easy structure for a longer answer.
tips.kk: Жаз бен қыс — толық жауапқа ыңғайлы құрылым.
tips.ru: Лето и зима — удобная структура для развёрнутого ответа.
tips.example: In summer we often go hiking in the mountains

tips.en: We’ll go — will for typical actions sounds natural.
tips.kk: We’ll go — әдеттегі әрекеттер үшін will табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: We’ll go — would/will для типичных действий звучит естественно.

questions.question: What do you usually do with your friends?

text: For me, the most important thing is being reliable — someone who's there for you when things go wrong, not just when it's fun. I also value honesty, even when it's uncomfortable, because a good friend will tell you if you're making a mistake.

tips.en: The quality is named and explained straight away.
tips.ru: Качество названо и сразу объяснено примером.
tips.example: someone who's there for you when things go wrong

tips.kk: Because адалдықтың неге маңызды екенін түсіндіреді.

title.en: A second quality with a reason

tips.example: because a good friend will tell you if you're making a mistake

questions.question: What makes someone a good friend?

text: Not as easy as at school, I'd say. At school you see the same people every day, so friendships happen naturally. As an adult, everyone's busy with work and family, so you have to make much more of an effort — joining a club or a sports team is probably the easiest way.

tips.en: School versus adult life — the comparison explains the answer.
tips.kk: Мектеп пен ересек өмір — салыстыру жауапты түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Школа и взрослая жизнь — сравнение объясняет ответ.
tips.example: At school you see the same people every day

tips.en: The answer ends with a solution, not just a problem.
tips.kk: Жауап мәселемен ғана емес, шешіммен аяқталады.
tips.ru: Ответ заканчивается решением, а не только проблемой.
tips.example: joining a club or a sports team is probably the easiest way

phrases.text: make much more of an effort

questions.question: Is it easy to make new friends as an adult?

text: All the time. We have a group chat that's active pretty much every day, mostly with jokes and plans for the weekend. I also have a couple of friends who moved abroad, and without video calls I think we'd have lost touch completely.

tips.en: The group, frequency and content — detail instead of a simple “yes”.
tips.kk: Топ, жиілік және мазмұн — жалпы «иә» орнына нақтылық.
tips.ru: Группа, частота и содержание — конкретика вместо общего «да».
tips.example: We have a group chat that's active pretty much every day

tips.en: Without… we’d have lost is complex grammar used naturally.
tips.kk: Without… we’d have lost — табиғи қолданылған күрделі грамматика.
tips.ru: Without… we’d have lost — сложная грамматика, использованная естественно.

questions.question: Do you keep in touch with friends online?
